A sequence of linked soils down a slope from crest to valley floor, differing because of drainage and position.
Thin sandy soils on the crest; deeper, more clay-rich soils at the foot; deep, dark, wet clay soils in the vlei (dambo).
The proportions of sand (2.0–0.05 mm), silt (0.05–0.002 mm) and clay (below 0.002 mm); the three add to 100%.
Eluviation: removal of material from a layer. Illuviation: deposition of that material in a lower layer.
Moisture (%) = (fresh mass − dry mass) ÷ fresh mass × 100 (or ÷ dry mass; state the base).

back: Organic matter (%) = (dry mass − mass after heating) ÷ dry mass × 100.
